disclaimer: Answers are their authors' opinions. A badge means the team verified the person's experience — it doesn't guarantee everything they write is correct.

welcome.title: What are you into? 👋
welcome.text: Pick the tracks you care about and their posts and questions will show up on your home. Pick at least one track.
welcome.branchesText: Every track has smaller communities. Keep "All" to get everything, or pick only the branches you care about.
welcome.pickBranch: Pick at least one branch, or "All".
welcome.later: You can change your picks anytime from the Communities page.

badges.intro: Badges help students know who has real experience. You apply with proof, and the team reviews it.
badges.tooltip: experience verified by the team; answers are their authors' opinions

expert.title: Expert badge
expert.text: A blue shield for someone with practical or academic experience in a specific track.
perks: A blue shield next to your name everywhere
Anyone who taps your shield sees the experience the team verified
Your name appears among badge holders

scholar.title: Academic badge
scholar.text: A green shield for doctors, researchers, trainers and certificate holders.
perks: A green shield next to your name everywhere
An experience page that shows your credentials when someone taps your shield
